results.detail: I re-derived this from SqlCommand DTSX:3975-4012 and update Standing Order main.cs (main.cs line 1 = DTSX:4215). It checks out on: the joins Gen_ftCurrentYear-Gen_fundmain (ft.gen_fundnumber = f.Gen_fundmainId), Gen_standingorder (so.gen_customeraccount = f.Gen_customeraccountname) and gen_banks; the filters = 0 on gen_isfirsttransactionreceivied/gen_ispastrecord (NULL excluded); '53'/'02'; account right(13 zeros + x, 12), branch and bank number; the amount and date per depositType = 2 / <> 2 (NULL matches neither); and ROW_NUMBER partition by ft.gen_transtotalamount, so.gen_bankname, so.gen_bankaccountnumber, so.gen_branch with RowNum = 1. Each order falls in exactly one partition, because its amount is fixed by its depositType, so at most one order is marked per combination. The write is statuscode = OptionSetValue(FIRST_TRANSACTION_RECEIVED = 100000009) and gen_isfirsttransactionreceivied = true (main.cs:84,126-127). In the scope note: there is no package configuration (no DTS:Configuration / dtsConfig in the file). [Prod] is used only by readers: the End ETL Lookup (DTSX:2247), the Get Organization Variables source (DTSX:2314) and the business source (DTSX:4020). [SSIS_Logs] is used only by the log provider (DTSX:16). The SDK writers are Create ETL Process record (DTSX:277, crmServiceProxy.Create), ETL Record Finish (DTSX:818, Update), ETL Warning (DTSX:3310, Create) and update Standing Order (DTSX:4343, service.Update). The SQL comments '--One time' / '--Not one time' are at DTSX:3998 and 4005. The type of Gen_CurrentAccountNumber is wstr(12) in the supplied 0008 insert into ftCurrentYearBase (0008:63163), so the string padding semantics hold. 'The only filter on the order' is read as the filter on the order's own flags; the matching conditions are listed right after it.

There are 4 executables. Get Organization Variables has no incoming constraint. Constraint (DTSX:5079) runs from Get Organization Variables to Create ETL Process record, Constraint 1 (DTSX:5080) to Update Standing Order First Transaction Received, and Constraint 5 (DTSX:5081) to End ETL Process record. None has DTS:Value or an expression, so all are Success. No executable is disabled.

results.detail: The decision in unit [2] asks only whether the customer's funds have a transaction from the same bank account, for the order amount and not before the charge date, and branch 'כן' leads to the write. It leaves out a row-selection condition: only transactions with Gen_TransTypeID = '53' and Gen_transgrouptypeid = '02' count (DTSX:3989-3990). Unit [8] mentions the codes only in a note on their meaning, not as a condition. The decision also does not say that an order with gen_depositType NULL never matches (DTSX:3999, 4006), even though such an order can meet the stated test. As written, an order with a matching transaction of another type, or with depositType NULL, would answer 'כן', but it is not marked. The other units are correct: [1] the flags = 0 with no state filter; [6] a not-updated order keeps flag 0 and is read again; [7] one order per amount and bank combination.
